newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks gain in London but lack direction.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks gain in London but lack direction.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks staged a modest recovery in very light trade in London on Tuesday, after falling slightly in Hong Kong, but the market remained largely rudderless, dealers said.
HSBC Holdings was the only stock that attracted much interest, climbing HK$1.50 to HK$193 in London from its previous close in Hong Kong.

"The market seems to be completely lacking direction, particularly since the market sold off in Hong Kong despite Wall Street's push higher," a London-based dealer said. "There just doesn't seem to be any momentum."
The Hang Seng London Reference Index nudged higher to 13,264, 11.9 points above its Hong Kong close.
